channel.title: V U This interactive TV and projector walkthroughs
channel.description: Result-first interactive workflows with printable PDFs and source-linked instructions.

item.title: Connect a Phone or Laptop to TV Without HDMI: Interactive Walkthrough
item.description: Connect a phone, tablet or laptop to a TV or projector browser. Follow the screen-code setup, then show a PDF, photos or a message without an HDMI cable from your controller. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-connect-phone-laptop-to-tv.pdf

item.title: Show a PDF on TV or a Projector Without HDMI: Interactive Guide
item.description: Display a PDF on TV or a projector from your phone or laptop. Follow Document, Show now, Fit page and Fit width with an interactive page-control illustration. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-pdf-on-tv-projector.pdf

item.title: PowerPoint, Google Slides and Keynote on TV Without HDMI
item.description: Show PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote or Canva slide pages on TV or a projector. Export to PDF, connect a controller and advance slides without an HDMI cable from your laptop. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-powerpoint-slides-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Show Photos and Run a TV Slideshow Without Casting
item.description: Show photos from your phone on TV without casting. Follow photo selection, order, slideshow timing, Pause, Resume, Fit and Fill in an interactive walkthrough. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-photos-slideshow-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Display Large Text and Welcome Messages on TV
item.description: Put large text on TV or a projector from your phone. Follow Text, message size, nine positions and colours to create a readable welcome or instruction screen. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-large-text-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Turn a TV into a Digital Notice Board: Interactive Walkthrough
item.description: Display announcements on TV from your phone. Build a notice with title, subtitle and footer, preview the hierarchy and update a reception or event screen. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-announcements-notice-board.pdf

item.title: Show a Full-Screen Clock or World Time on TV
item.description: Put a full-screen clock on TV and control it from your phone. Choose local time or a time zone, a clear label, 12/24-hour format, seconds and date. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-clock-world-time-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Countdown, Count-Up and Presentation Timer on TV
item.description: Control a full-screen TV or projector timer from your phone. Explore Down, Up and To a time, with labels, Pause, Resume and Restart for meetings and workshops. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-presentation-timer-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Display a Now-Serving Number or Tally Counter on TV
item.description: Put a live tally or now-serving number on TV and control it from your phone. Set the start, Step and label, then count up, count down or reset. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-now-serving-tally-counter.pdf

item.title: Display a Website QR Code on TV for Menus, Agendas and Feedback
item.description: Show a website QR code on TV or a projector. Add the full link and a useful caption so visitors can open a menu, agenda, registration page or feedback form. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-website-qr-code-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Show a Guest Wi-Fi QR Code on a Hotel or Meeting-Room TV
item.description: Display a guest Wi-Fi QR code on TV. Enter authorised network details, add a clear caption and test joining from another phone for meetings, hotels and events. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-guest-wifi-qr-on-tv.pdf

item.title: Build a Digital Signage Playlist on TV Without a New Media Player
item.description: Create a browser digital signage playlist with photos, PDFs, text, announcements, clocks, timers, counters and QR codes. Follow Add to queue, order, Auto and Loop. Open https://vuthis.com on the display. Printable guide: https://vuthis.github.io/walkthrough-digital-signage-playlist.pdf
